$launch_env_comment: PromoPilot refuses to boot without ADMIN_TOKEN ('FATAL: set ADMIN_TOKEN — PromoPilot refuses to run open to the world.'). The runner never supplied its declared required_env, so a perfectly startable app reported startup_failed every night. ADMIN_TOKEN/CRED_SECRET are GENERATED per run (never committed); PROMO_ENABLED=false keeps the posting scheduler off, which the prohibited_actions require.
seed_command: none (SQLite auto-initializes at SQLITE_PATH; no external DB needed)
reset_command: delete disposable SQLite file at SQLITE_PATH and restart
cleanup: rm -rf .eva-tmp/promopilot && remove disposable SQLite db at SQLITE_PATH
prohibited_actions: CRITICAL: NO real social-media post — run with PROMO_ENABLED=false AND zero platform credentials configured (the scheduler defaults ON)

coverage.unautomated_reason: behind the single-owner token login; add-app/upload-asset flows require an authenticated token session not yet wired into fixtures
requires token login; any campaign action risks touching the posting scheduler, and real posting is prohibited
requires token login and posting history; posting itself is prohibited so the log stays empty in a disposable instance

$expected_console_comment: The unlocked console fetches token-gated endpoints on load, so an UNAUTHENTICATED visit logs a 401 by design. Measured 2026-08-01 once the app could finally boot. Declaring it keeps a by-design 401 from reddening the report every night; it can never suppress an assertion failure.

journeys.name: Root page loads and identifies PromoPilot (or its login gate)
journeys.user_impact: If the root page does not load, the owner cannot reach the console at all.

journeys.name: Token unlock view renders an input for the admin token
journeys.user_impact: Without the token unlock input, the single-owner login is impossible and the whole console is locked out.
